subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this one-tick defer as the fix for the linked session-state race?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the PR is external, user-visible, session-state-sensitive, and still lacks after-fix proof from a real OpenClaw runner or Feishu path.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge on the focused source and test evidence while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issues
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked behind the linked Feishu and long-session reports until someone can produce real transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.
